reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       MIN(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Gaming' THEN order_date END) AS first_gaming_date,
       MIN(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN order_date END) AS first_accessories_date
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code
